title: Ministries
body: Maintain the role catalog for ministries you lead. Retired roles stay on historical assignments but cannot be used for new ones.

notLeader: You must lead a ministry to manage its role catalog.

churchSettings.intro: Update your accredited church display name and default timezone. Event times in UTC are unchanged.

churchSettings.title: Church settings
churchSettings.body: Update the active church name and default timezone. Event times stay stored in UTC; changing timezone only affects how times are shown.
churchSettings.timezoneHint: Use an IANA timezone such as America/New_York or UTC.

errors.notAccredited: You are not accredited for this church.

campusSettings.title: Campus settings
campusSettings.body: Update the active campus name and IANA timezone. Event times stay stored in UTC; changing timezone only affects how times are shown for this campus.
campusSettings.timezoneHint: Use an IANA timezone such as America/Sao_Paulo or UTC.

errors.notAccredited: You are not accredited for this church.

confirm.title: Change campus timezone?
confirm.body: Existing event and assignment times in UTC are unchanged. Local display for this campus will use the new timezone.

structure.title: Ministry structure
structure.body: Create and rename ministries for the active church. Renames keep the same ministry ID so memberships, roles, assignments, and time away history stay connected.

delegation.title: Delegate leaders
delegation.body: Grant or revoke ministry-scoped leader stewardship. Delegation is limited to churches where you are an accredited admin.
delegation.signInRequired: Sign in to manage leader delegation.
